在半月湾安排半天，不必从港口一路赶到南面的观景点。把车或接送终点定在一个清楚的入: A half-day in Half Moon Bay doesn't need to stretch from the harbor to viewpoints farther south. Choose a clear entrance as your parking or drop-off point, walk a coastal trail you can retrace, and keep lunch nearby. That makes the day easier to manage. This plan centers on Francis Beach for ocean views and walking, not swimming, chasing sunset, or covering the entire coastline.
先确认入口，别只输入“Half Moon Bay”: Confirm the entrance; don't just enter “Half Moon Bay”
州立公园列出的 Francis Beach 主入口是 95 Kelly Aven: The state park lists Francis Beach's main entrance at 95 Kelly Avenue; the city's page also places it at the end of Kelly Avenue. Before leaving, check the state park page for construction notices, openings, and parking. Parking, camping, and daytime walks are different arrangements. A camping reservation link doesn't mean a walk requires booking a campsite.
自驾先保存入口与回程路线；拼车则约定同一个接送点。无车者要把到半月湾之后的最后一: If driving, save the entrance and return route; if carpooling, agree on one pickup and drop-off point. Without a car, check the final stretch after reaching Half Moon Bay separately: a bus into town doesn't necessarily reach the beach. This guide assumes no set drive time; reassess the route over the hills from your starting point that day.
主线沿铺装步道走，沙滩是可选项: Stay on paved paths for the main route; the beach is optional
从 Francis Beach 日间入口出发，沿 Coastside Trail: Start at the Francis Beach day-use entrance and follow Coastside Trail north toward Venice Beach. Choose your turnaround point based on stamina and that day's access, then return the same way to Francis Beach. Venice is only the farthest optional destination; turning back sooner still completes the outing.
先读公告牌，确认回程集合点、可用卫生间与步道入口。: Read the notice board first. Confirm your return meeting point, available restrooms, and the trail entrance.
Coastside Trail 北向短段: A short northbound stretch of Coastside Trail
走铺装海岸步道，留意自行车与交叉通道，不踩沙丘捷径。: Follow the paved coastal trail, watch for bicycles and crossings, and don't shortcut through dunes.
到 Venice Beach 入口一带或更早折返；遇封闭按现场指引停止延伸。: Turn back near the Venice Beach entrance or earlier. Stop extending the route if signs indicate a closure.
回日间休息区吃自带午餐，收拾好再返程，不临时追加远处海滩。: Return to the day-use area for your packed lunch, clean up, then head home. Don't add a distant beach on impulse.
下到沙滩前，重新判断海况: Reassess ocean conditions before stepping onto the sand
National Weather Service 提醒，短暂平静之后也可能突然出: The National Weather Service warns that larger waves can suddenly reach farther up shore after a calm spell and can move driftwood. Check local surf and tide advisories before leaving, and keep watching the ocean on arrival. Leave room to retreat, stay away from driftwood near the surf, and never turn your back on the ocean. If a beach hazard advisory is in effect, stay on open shore-side trails or visit another day.
带狗、带推车，各有一道确认: Dogs and strollers each need an extra check
Half Moon Bay State Beach 的沙滩禁止狗进入；Coast: Dogs are prohibited on the sand at Half Moon Bay State Beach. Leashed dogs are allowed on Coastside Trail and in designated day-use picnic areas, with a leash no longer than six feet. Other city beaches may have different managers and rules. Paved paths are easier with a stroller, but sand is a separate challenge. If you need a beach wheelchair, check lending arrangements and on-site availability with the Francis entrance station first.
把半天收在一张小清单里: Put your half-day plan into a short checklist
带防风外层、水、容易收好的食物和垃圾袋；先在家分装，减少海边展开的东西。: Bring a wind-resistant outer layer, water, easy-to-pack food, and a trash bag. Portion food at home to keep beach setup simple.
把返程时间告诉同行者，走出一段后同时考虑走回去需要的体力。: Tell companions when you plan to return, and remember to save enough energy to walk back.
下沙滩前确认当前警示与上岸通道；不生火，不拿贝壳、漂木等自然物作纪念。: Before going onto the beach, check current warnings and your way back up. Don't light fires or take shells, driftwood, or other natural items as souvenirs.
午餐后检查座位四周，把包装与食物残渣一起带走；风大时提前结束。: After lunch, check around your seat and take away packaging and food scraps. Finish early if the wind picks up.
